newsitem.title: USA: Carson says unit in S.African purchase talks.
newsitem.headline: Carson says unit in S.African purchase talks.

text.p: Hair care products company Carson Inc repeated late on Wednesday that its South African subsidiary, Carson Holdings Ltd, was in talks to acquire a South African a hair care and cosmetics company.

"If successful, the acquisition of Black Like Me is expected to more than double the size of Carson's African business and position the company as one of the leading South African manufacturers and marketers of products targeted to black consumers," the company said in a release.
On Monday, the subsidiary urged its shareholders to exercise caution, stating that it was in merger talks with Johannesburg-based, Black Like Me Products Ltd.
Carson Inc's products include the brand names Dark & Lovely, Excelle, Beautiful Beginnings, Dark & Natural, and Magic.
The company's shares closed Wednesday at 12-5/8, off 1/8.
